up: Retrieve distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL4433236. Only include molecules with canonical_smiles available. Order rows by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cr.compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4433236'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles;
